title: Prime Gap BddAbove Foundation
content: primeGap_le_x proves every gap d = q-p satisfies d <= x (since d <= q <= x). primeGapSet_bddAbove wraps this as BddAbove, enabling sSup.
mathContext: $d = q - p \leq q \leq x$, so $\{d\} \subseteq [0, x]$ and $\text{BddAbove}(\text{primeGapSet}(x))$.

title: Maximal Prime Gap Bounded by x
content: maxPrimeGap_le proves sSup(primeGapSet x) <= x. Case split: if nonempty, use csSup_le with the bound from primeGap_le_x; if empty, csSup_empty gives 0.
mathContext: $G(x) = \sup\{d \mid d \text{ is a prime gap below } x\} \leq x$.

title: Prime Gap <= Previous Prime (via Bertrand)
content: prime_gap_le_prev_prime proves q-p <= p for consecutive primes p < q. Uses Nat.bertrand to get a prime r with p < r <= 2p. Since q is the next prime after p, the consecutiveness condition gives q <= r, so q - p <= r - p <= 2p - p = p.
mathContext: Bertrand: $\exists r$ prime, $p < r \leq 2p$. Consecutiveness: $q \leq r$. So $q - p \leq 2p - p = p$.

title: Maximal Gap <= x/2 (from Bertrand)
content: maxPrimeGap_le_half proves G(x) <= x/2 for x >= 25. From prime_gap_le_prev_prime: d = q-p <= p, so 2d <= d+p = q <= x, giving d <= x/2.
mathContext: $d \leq p$ and $d + p = q \leq x$, so $2d \leq x$, i.e., $d \leq x/2$.

title: Cramer Sublinearity: C*(log x)^2 = o(x)
content: cramer_implies_gap_sublinear proves: for all epsilon>0 and C>0, C*(log x)^2 <= epsilon*x for x >= ceil((16C/epsilon)^2)+1. The proof chains: (1) Real.log_le_rpow_div with delta=1/4 gives log x <= 4*x^(1/4), (2) squaring with rpow_mul gives (log x)^2 <= 16*x^(1/2), (3) comparing 16C*x^(1/2) <= epsilon*x when 16C/epsilon <= x^(1/2).
mathContext: $\log x \leq 4x^{1/4} \Rightarrow (\log x)^2 \leq 16x^{1/2}$. Then $16C \cdot x^{1/2} \leq \varepsilon \cdot x$ when $x \geq (16C/\varepsilon)^2$.

title: Monotonicity of Prime Gap Sets and Maximal Gaps
content: primeGapSet_mono: if x <= y then primeGapSet x is a subset of primeGapSet y (just weaken the q <= x bound). maxPrimeGap_mono: follows from csSup_le_csSup with the subset and BddAbove.
